channel.description: Latest articles from South Florida Sun Sentinel (sunsentinel.com)

item.title: Trump threatens Canada with 50% tariff on aircraft sold in US, expanding trade war
item.description: It's the latest salvo in his trade war with Canada and Prime Minister Mark Carney.

item.title: House probe finds ‘substantial evidence’ of criminal misconduct, ethics violations by Cherfilus-McCormick
item.description: An investigative subcommittee that spent months examining U.S. Rep. Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick has found “substantial evidence of conduct” described in a criminal indictment against her last year.

item.title: Trump threatens tariffs on any country selling oil to Cuba, a move that puts pressure on Mexico
item.description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said her government had temporarily stopped oil shipments to Cuba.

item.title: Jury finds Wisconsin man guilty of forging threat against Trump to get witness deported
item.description: The jury found Demetric Scott guilty of identity theft and witness intimidation.

item.title: FACT FOCUS: A look at false and misleading claims made during Trump’s first Cabinet meeting of 2026
item.description: Some of the president's boasts were off the mark.

item.title: Olympic gold medalist Sha’Carri Richardson charged with speeding at 104 mph near Orlando
item.description: Olympic gold medalist Sha’Carri Richardson was arrested for allegedly speeding 104 mph on a parkway just outside of Orlando.

item.title: Judge orders Florida elections division to update pot petition numbers on website
item.description: Judge ruled that the Florida Division of Elections is required to update its website to reflect the number of valid signatures for a proposed recreational-marijuana constitutional amendment.

item.title: Heat open three-game set vs. Bulls with 116-113 victory in survival mode
item.description: One more win ... and the Miami Heat break out the brooms? No, not normal NBA scheduling, but it is where the Heat find themselves, in the midst of three consecutive games against the Bulls.

item.title: Winderman’s view: No-excuse Heat with no-excuse win in postponement rematch
item.description: Ira Winderman's perspectives and other items of note from the Miami Heat's Thursday night game against the Chicago Bulls.

item.title: Snuggerud scores with 7.6 seconds left, Blues stun Panthers
item.description: Matthew Tkachuk had scored two quick goals, his first of the season, to even the score 4-4.
